revenue.source: Total revenues (incl. other income), consolidated: FY2023/FY2024 from Eni Annual Report 2024 consolidated income statement; FY2025 from Eni 2025 Consolidated Financial Statements press release (Mar 2026)

operating_income.source: Reported operating profit (loss), after impairments: Eni AR2024 (FY2023, FY2024); Eni 2025 consolidated financial statements PR (FY2025). Adjusted EBIT is higher (FY2025 8,344).

d_and_a.source: Depreciation, depletion and amortization: Eni AR2024 income statement (FY2023, FY2024); FY2025 from 2025 consolidated financial statements PR cash flow adjustments. Excludes impairments.

capex.source: Capital expenditure per Eni Financial Review AR2025 / AR2024 / Q4 2025 results PR (excludes acquisitions of subsidiaries/investments)

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: between FY2025 reported margin 6.0% (5,010/83,629, after 1.6bn impairments) and adjusted ~10% (adj. EBIT 8,344); normalised mid-cycle.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Eni's E&P-heavy mix carries high effective tax rates (FY2024 income taxes 3,725 on pre-tax 6,489 = 57%; FY2023 52%); 40% used as normalised rate, reviewer should check.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 8,647/83,629 = 10.3%; Eni 2026 guidance gross capex ~EUR7bn (~8.5% of revenue); 9% assumed

wacc.source: Assumption: typical integrated oil & gas/European utility-like WACC ~7.5-8.5% (not computed from market data)

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run inflation, reflecting energy-transition risk to hydrocarbons

net_debt.source: Eni Q4/FY2025 results PR: net borrowings before lease liabilities ex IFRS 16 at 31 Dec 2025 (total finance debt less cash and liquid investments, excluding leases)

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares FY2025 (millions), Eni 2025 Consolidated Financial Statements PR
